cases.purpose: Independently assert both thaw spellings resume a blocked writer and preserve its content; require EBUSY for the frozen probe and EINVAL for a subsequent thaw.
cases.oracle: util-linux 2.41 fsfreeze; util-linux fsfreeze -f as the frozen-state probe
cases.comparison: Each side asserts the kernel and content outcomes and emits the same success markers; any failed assertion fails the case.
cases.script:
RT=/tmp/rt; /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$RT" || exit 99
seed() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; n=int(sys.argv[2]); open(sys.argv[1],"wb").write(bytes((i*7+i//251)%256 for i in range(n)))' "$1" "$2"; }
settle() { /usr/bin/udevadm settle -t 10 >/dev/null 2>&1; }
gone() { local x=${1#/dev/} i; for ((i=0;i<50;i++)); do [[ -e /sys/block/$x/loop/backing_file ]] || return 0; /usr/bin/sleep 0.1; done; echo "  $x still attached" >&2; return 1; }
detach() { /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$1" && gone "$1"; }
mkext() {
  /usr/bin/truncate -s 8M img && /usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4 -q -F -O ^has_journal -E nodiscard,lazy_itable_init=0 -U 0b0e0e0e-1111-4222-8333-444444444441 img || exit 99
  dev=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -f --show img) || exit 99
  settle || exit 99
  /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$M" && /usr/bin/mount "$dev" "$M" || exit 99
  mounted=1
}
fail() { echo "FAIL: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
M=/tmp/rt/mnt; dev=; wp=; mounted=0
cleanup() {
  local rc=$? bad=0
  trap - EXIT
  if (( mounted )); then /usr/sbin/fsfreeze -u "$M" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
  if [[ -n $wp ]]; then kill "$wp" 2>/dev/null || :; wait "$wp" 2>/dev/null || :; fi
  cd /tmp/parity-case || bad=1
  if (( mounted )); then /usr/bin/umount "$M" || bad=1; fi
  if [[ -n $dev ]]; then detach "$dev" || bad=1; fi
  if (( bad )); then echo "FAIL: teardown" >&2; exit 1; fi
  exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
cd "$RT" || fail cd
mkext
seed /tmp/fsfreeze-input 8192 || fail seed
/usr/bin/cp /tmp/fsfreeze-input "$M/read" || fail initial-write
for pair in short long; do
  if [[ $pair == short ]]; then freeze=-f; thaw=-u; else freeze=--freeze; thaw=--unfreeze; fi
  fsfreeze "$freeze" "$M" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err || fail "$pair freeze"
  [[ ! -s /tmp/rf.out && ! -s /tmp/rf.err ]] || fail "$pair freeze output"
  /usr/sbin/fsfreeze -f "$M" >/tmp/probe.out 2>/tmp/probe.err
  rc=$?
  [[ $rc == 1 && ! -s /tmp/probe.out ]] && /usr/bin/grep -Fq 'Device or resource busy' /tmp/probe.err || fail "$pair frozen probe"
  /usr/bin/cmp /tmp/fsfreeze-input "$M/read" || fail "$pair frozen read"
  /usr/bin/timeout -k 2 15 /usr/bin/dd if=/tmp/fsfreeze-input of="$M/write-$pair" bs=4096 conv=fsync status=none & wp=$!
  /usr/bin/sleep 1
  kill -0 "$wp" 2>/dev/null || fail "$pair writer finished while frozen"
  fsfreeze "$thaw" "$M" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err || fail "$pair thaw"
  [[ ! -s /tmp/rf.out && ! -s /tmp/rf.err ]] || fail "$pair thaw output"
  wait "$wp" || fail "$pair writer did not complete"; wp=
  /usr/bin/cmp /tmp/fsfreeze-input "$M/write-$pair" || fail "$pair content"
  /usr/bin/cp /tmp/fsfreeze-input "$M/after-$pair" || fail "$pair later write"
  /usr/bin/cmp /tmp/fsfreeze-input "$M/after-$pair" || fail "$pair later content"
  echo "$pair freeze-thaw-resume=ok"
done
fsfreeze -u "$M" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; rc=$?
[[ $rc == 1 && ! -s /tmp/rf.out ]] && /usr/bin/grep -Fq unfreeze /tmp/rf.err && /usr/bin/grep -Fq 'Invalid argument' /tmp/rf.err || fail unfrozen-thaw
echo unfrozen-thaw=ok
